name: CoDI-Eval
description: CoDI-Eval is a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate large language models' ability to follow instructions with explicit constraints. It includes a large collection of constraint-attributed instructions and automates evaluation to assess controllability in instruction-following.
reputation: A newer benchmark for controllable instruction following that is cited in recent work but has not yet become a widely adopted standard.
notes: Focuses on evaluating LLMs' responses to instructions with various constraints, highlighting gaps between open-source and closed-source models.
